card.name: Words before the diluent fluid name
card.fires_on: Linking words such as "of", "containing" and "with" right after an infusion bag or a volume in mL, where the next words name the fluid, e.g. 0.9% Sodium Chloride or 5% Dextrose.

modes.label: Bag containing fluid
modes.description: "containing" or "with" after an infusion bag or diluted drug, ahead of the diluent name.

modes.label: Volume of fluid
modes.description: "of" right after a volume in mL, ahead of a solution or body fluid.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words for liquids and mixtures, such as liquids, fluids and mixture.
card.plain: It marks the spot where the text is about to name the fluid a drug is mixed into.
